title: Creator Kit
description: A toolkit for creators to package and share audio-first workflows.

details.overview: Creator Kit explores how sound-led products can feel as deliberate as visual interfaces — from packing assets to presenting a finished listening experience.
details.challenge: Audio tools often bury the listening experience under dense controls and file management, making it hard for creators to present polished work.
details.solution: We designed a focused packaging flow with clear hierarchy, calm motion, and a shareable presentation layer that keeps the audio front and center.
features: Responsive layout tuned for desktop and mobile
